Definition: from G3445; formation, i.e. (by implication), appearance (semblance or (concretely) formula):--form.
BiblicalUsage: Morphosis is the form, the outward appearance — the Jew has the form of knowledge and of truth in the law, and in the last days men will have a form of godliness but deny its power.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the form without the power is the oldest counterfeit: it looks right and does nothing.
